"""Qualify available upstream Linux lanes using explicitly prepared local tools.

Run in Linux/WSL after preparing its scratch grammar, Node, Go, Tree-sitter CLI
and Python build dependencies. No global installation or source checkout writes.
Rust is opt-in with an explicit toolchain path; Swift remains a separate lane.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import sys
import time

from grammar_runtime import digest, runtime_digest, scratch_grammar
from grammar_layout import generated_digests, layout_digest, lint_sources, parser_commitment, parser_digests, parser_roots

GENERATED = ("src/parser.c", "src/grammar.json", "src/node-types.json")


def main():
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    ap.add_argument("--grammar", type=Path, required=True)
    ap.add_argument("--tools", type=Path, required=True)
    ap.add_argument("--cli", type=Path, required=True)
    ap.add_argument("--abi", type=int, choices=(14, 15), default=15)
    ap.add_argument("--node-bin", type=Path)
    ap.add_argument("--node-peer-version", choices=("0.21.1", "0.25.0"), default="0.25.0")
    ap.add_argument("--rust-bin", type=Path)
    ap.add_argument("--go-oracle", type=Path, help="Additional authored parser-installation check")
    ap.add_argument("--wasm", action="store_true")
    ap.add_argument("--skip-node-tests", action="store_true", help="Record an upstream-disabled Node binding lane; lint still runs")
    ap.add_argument("--prepared-npm", action="store_true", help="Use the materializer's separately receipted locked install, preserving qualified dependency patches")
    ap.add_argument("--out", type=Path, required=True)
    args = ap.parse_args()
    if sys.platform != "linux":
        raise ValueError("Linux lane requires a Linux process")
    grammar, prepared = scratch_grammar(args.grammar), args.tools.resolve(strict=True)
    out = args.out.resolve()
    out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False)
    node_bin = args.node_bin.resolve(strict=True) if args.node_bin else prepared / "node-v25.1.0-linux-x64/bin"
    cli = args.cli.resolve(strict=True)
    env = os.environ.copy()
    (out / "parser-cache").mkdir()
    env["TREE_SITTER_LIBDIR"] = str(out / "parser-cache")
    rust_path = ":" + str(args.rust_bin.resolve(strict=True)) if args.rust_bin else ""
    env.update(PATH=str(node_bin) + ":" + str(prepared / "go/bin") + rust_path + ":/usr/bin:/bin",
               PYTHONPATH=str(grammar / "bindings/python") + ":" + str(prepared / "python-deps"),
               GOTOOLCHAIN="local", CGO_ENABLED="1", GOCACHE=str(prepared / "go-cache"),
               GOPATH=str(prepared / "go-path"), npm_config_cache=str(prepared / "npm-cache"),
               npm_config_devdir=str(prepared / "node-headers"))
    rows = []

    def current_parser_digest():
        return parser_commitment(grammar)

    def run(name, command, cwd=grammar, extra_env=None):
        parser_before = current_parser_digest()

"""Run the upstream Windows binding lanes on a prepared scratch grammar.

Tool installation and Node's tree-sitter peer build are separate preparation.
Force fresh grammar builds; a failed build prevents its dependent smoke test.
This records upstream smoke tests, not semantic binding or platform equivalence.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import sys
import time

from grammar_runtime import digest, runtime_digest, scratch_grammar
from grammar_layout import layout_digest, lint_sources, parser_abi, parser_commitment, parser_digests


def main():
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    ap.add_argument("--grammar", type=Path, required=True)
    ap.add_argument("--cli", type=Path, required=True)
    ap.add_argument("--node-gyp", type=Path, required=True)
    ap.add_argument("--node-modules", type=Path, required=True)
    ap.add_argument("--cargo-target", type=Path, required=True)
    ap.add_argument("--go", type=Path)
    ap.add_argument("--go-oracle", type=Path, help="Additional authored parser-installation check")
    ap.add_argument("--skip-node-tests", action="store_true", help="Record an upstream-disabled Node binding lane; lint still runs")
    ap.add_argument("--out", type=Path, required=True)
    args = ap.parse_args()
    if sys.platform != "win32":
        raise ValueError("this lane qualifies Windows only")
    grammar = scratch_grammar(args.grammar)
    out = args.out.resolve()
    out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False)
    cli, node_gyp, node_modules = (p.resolve(strict=True) for p in (args.cli, args.node_gyp, args.node_modules))
    env = os.environ.copy()
    # The C++20 override used to build Node 25's runtime is invalid for grammar C.
    env.pop("_CL_", None)
    env.pop("CL", None)
    env["NODE_PATH"] = str(node_modules)
    env["PYTHONPATH"] = str(grammar / "bindings/python")
    env["CARGO_TARGET_DIR"] = str(args.cargo_target.resolve())
    # Variants share the grammar export name. Even --rebuild can race with a
    # second process in the default loader cache; isolate each run's library.
    env["TREE_SITTER_LIBDIR"] = str(out / "parser-cache")
    (out / "parser-cache").mkdir()
    parser_digest = parser_commitment(grammar)
    abi = parser_abi(grammar)
    rows = []

    def current_parser_digest():
        return parser_commitment(grammar)

    def run(name, command, *, extra_env=None):
        parser_before = current_parser_digest()
        start = time.perf_counter()
        result = subprocess.run(list(map(str, command)), cwd=grammar, env={**env, **(extra_env or {})},
                                capture_output=True, timeout=300)
        log = out / (name + ".log")
        log.write_bytes(result.stdout + result.stderr)
        rows.append({"lane": name, "command": list(map(str, command)), "cwd": str(grammar),
                     "exit_code": result.returncode, "wall_seconds": time.perf_counter() - start,
                     "log": str(log), "log_digest": digest(log.read_bytes()), "parser_digest": parser_before,
                     "parser_digest_after": current_parser_digest()})
        print(json.dumps({"lane": name, "exit_code": result.returncode}), flush=True)
        return result.returncode == 0

    versions = [("node-version", ["node", "--version"]), ("rust-version", ["rustc", "-Vv"]),
                ("cargo-version", ["cargo", "--version"]), ("python-version", [sys.executable, "--version"]),
                ("generator-version", [cli, "--version"]), ("cmake-version", ["cmake", "--version"])]
    for name, command in versions:
        if not run(name, command):
            raise ValueError("missing required tool: " + name)
    run("rust", ["cargo", "test", "--locked", "--quiet"])
    if run("python-build", [sys.executable, "setup.py", "build_ext", "--force", "--inplace"]):
        run("python-test", [sys.executable, "-m", "unittest", "discover", "-s", "bindings/python/tests", "-v"])
    if not args.skip_node_tests and run("node-build", ["node", node_gyp, "rebuild"]):
        run("node-test", ["node", "--test", "bindings/node/binding_test.js"])
    run("lint", ["node", grammar / "node_modules/eslint/bin/eslint.js", *lint_sources(grammar)])
    cmake_build = out / "cmake-build"
    if run("c-configure", ["cmake", "-S", ".", "-B", cmake_build, "-D", "TREE_SITTER_CLI=" + str(cli),
                           "-D", "TREE_SITTER_ABI_VERSION=" + str(abi)]):
        run("c-build", ["cmake", "--build", cmake_build, "--config", "Release", "--clean-first"])
    if args.go:
        run("go", [args.go.resolve(strict=True), "test", "./bindings/go"],
            extra_env={"CGO_ENABLED": "1", "GOTOOLCHAIN": "local"})
        if args.go_oracle:
            run("go-parser-oracle", [args.go.resolve(strict=True), "run", args.go_oracle.resolve(strict=True)],
                extra_env={"CGO_ENABLED": "1", "GOTOOLCHAIN": "local"})
    parser_unchanged = all(row["parser_digest"] == parser_digest == row["parser_digest_after"] for row in rows)
    passed = all(row["exit_code"] == 0 for row in rows) and parser_unchanged
    report = {"format": "entmoot.grammar_bindings.v1", "grammar": str(grammar),
              "driver_digest": digest(Path(__file__).read_bytes()), "runtime_driver_digest": runtime_digest(), "parser_digest": parser_digest,
              "parser_abi": abi, "parser_unchanged": parser_unchanged, "parser_files": parser_digests(grammar), "layout_driver_digest": layout_digest(),
              "node_tests_requested": not args.skip_node_tests,
              "inputs": {p: digest((grammar / p).read_bytes()) for p in
                         ("grammar.js", "src/scanner.c", "Cargo.toml", "Cargo.lock", "package-lock.json") if (grammar / p).exists()},
              "environment": {key: env[key] for key in ("NODE_PATH", "PYTHONPATH", "CARGO_TARGET_DIR", "TREE_SITTER_LIBDIR")},
              "rows": rows, "requested_commands_passed": passed,
              "limits": ["Only Windows upstream smoke tests; no Entmoot semantic binding qualification",
                         "Go is unrun unless explicitly supplied; missing CGo compiler is a failed lane",
                         "Swift and Linux/macOS lanes are not exercised by this driver",
                         "Prepared Node runtime peer and tool installation are separately recorded build inputs"]}
    (out / "summary.json").write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
    raise SystemExit(0 if passed else 1)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

"""Separate C/C++ CST, explicit compiler mode and actual runtime observations."""
import argparse
import importlib.util
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import sys

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent))
from grammar_runtime import digest, endpoint, load_language, nodes, runtime_digest, shape
import tree_sitter

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent


def main():
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    ap.add_argument("--language", choices=("c", "cpp"), required=True)
    ap.add_argument("--libraries", type=Path, required=True, help="Variant to platform library path mapping")
    ap.add_argument("--clang-root", type=Path, required=True, help="Prepared Linux release with bin/ and lib/")
    ap.add_argument("--out", type=Path, required=True)
    args = ap.parse_args()
    out = args.out.resolve()
    out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False)
    fixture_path = ROOT / args.language / "cases.py"
    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("authored_c_family_cases", fixture_path)
    fixtures = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
    spec.loader.exec_module(fixtures)
    handles, parsers, libraries = [], {}, []
    for variant, name in json.loads(args.libraries.read_text(encoding="utf-8")).items():
        path = Path(name).resolve(strict=True)
        handle, grammar = load_language(path, args.language)
        handles.append(handle)
        parsers[variant] = tree_sitter.Parser(grammar)
        libraries.append({"variant": variant, "path": str(path), "digest": digest(path.read_bytes())})
    clang = args.clang_root.resolve(strict=True)

    def native_path(path):
        path = Path(path).absolute().as_posix()
        if os.name == "nt":
            if not path.startswith("G:/"):
                raise ValueError("WSL inputs must be on the recorded G drive")
            return "/mnt/g/" + path[3:]
        return path

    compiler = native_path(clang / "bin" / ("clang++" if args.language == "cpp" else "clang"))
    env = {key: value for key, value in os.environ.items() if key not in
           ("CPATH", "C_INCLUDE_PATH", "CPLUS_INCLUDE_PATH", "OBJC_INCLUDE_PATH", "LIBRARY_PATH")}
    env["LD_LIBRARY_PATH"] = native_path(clang / "lib")
    prefix = (["wsl", "-d", "Ubuntu", "--", "env", "-u", "CPATH", "-u", "C_INCLUDE_PATH", "-u", "CPLUS_INCLUDE_PATH",
               "-u", "OBJC_INCLUDE_PATH", "-u", "LIBRARY_PATH", "LD_LIBRARY_PATH=" + env["LD_LIBRARY_PATH"]] if os.name == "nt" else [])
    version = subprocess.check_output([*prefix, compiler, "--version"], env=env, text=True)
    if not version.startswith("clang version 23.1.3 "):
        raise ValueError("pinned Clang 23.1.3 required")
    manifest = {"format": "entmoot.c_family_feature_inputs.v1", "language": args.language,
                "driver_digest": digest(Path(__file__).read_bytes()), "fixture_digest": digest(fixture_path.read_bytes()),
                "runtime_driver_digest": runtime_digest(), "libraries": libraries, "compiler_version": version,
                "compiler_root": str(clang), "compiler_digest": digest((clang / "bin/clang-23").read_bytes()),
                "cases": [{"id": case["id"], "mode": case["mode"], "source_digest": digest(case["source"].encode("utf-8"))}
                          for case in fixtures.CASES]}
    manifest_path = out / "input_manifest.json"
    manifest_path.write_text(json.dumps(manifest, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8", newline="\n")
    rows = []

    def run(command, directory, name):
        result = subprocess.run([*prefix, *command], env=env, capture_output=True, timeout=90)
        raw = result.stdout + result.stderr
        (directory / (name + ".log")).write_bytes(raw)
        return {"command": [*prefix, *command], "exit_code": result.returncode,
                "output": raw.decode("utf-8", "replace"), "log_digest": digest(raw)}

    for case in fixtures.CASES:
        directory = out / case["id"]
        directory.mkdir()
        raw = case["source"].encode("utf-8")
        source = directory / ("fixture.cpp" if args.language == "cpp" else "fixture.c")
        source.write_bytes(raw)
        support = []
        for name, contents in case.get("files", {}).items():
            target = (directory / name).resolve()
            if not target.is_relative_to(directory):
                raise ValueError("support file escapes fixture")
            data = bytes.fromhex(contents["hex"]) if isinstance(contents, dict) else contents.encode("utf-8")
            target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            target.write_bytes(data)
            support.append({"path": name, "digest": digest(data)})
        csts = []
        for variant, parser in parsers.items():
            tree = parser.parse(raw)
            initial_error = tree.root_node.has_error
            sites = []
            for expected in case["sites"]:
                matches = [node for node in nodes(tree.root_node) if node.type == expected["kind"] and
                           raw[node.start_byte:node.end_byte].decode("utf-8") == expected["text"]]
                ordinal = expected.get("ordinal", 0)
                unique = len(matches) == 1 if "ordinal" not in expected else ordinal < len(matches)
                found = matches[ordinal] if unique else None
                fields = {field: (raw[child.start_byte:child.end_byte].decode("utf-8") if child else None)
                          for field in expected.get("fields", {})
                          for child in [found.child_by_field_name(field) if found else None]}
                sites.append({"expected": expected, "match_count": len(matches), "fields": fields,
                              "span": ({"bytes": [found.start_byte, found.end_byte],
                                        "points": [list(found.start_point), list(found.end_point)]} if found else None),
                              "passed": unique and fields == expected.get("fields", {})})
            sibling = any(node.type == "function_definition" and raw[node.start_byte:node.end_byte].decode("utf-8") == case["after"]
                          for node in tree.root_node.named_children)
            recovered = None
            if not initial_error:
                expected_shape = shape(tree)
                inserted = b"int broken = ;\n"
                tree.edit(start_byte=0, old_end_byte=0, new_end_byte=len(inserted), start_point=(0, 0), old_end_point=(0, 0), new_end_point=endpoint(inserted))
                broken = parser.parse(inserted + raw, tree)
                had_error = broken.root_node.has_error
                broken.edit(start_byte=0, old_end_byte=len(inserted), new_end_byte=0, start_point=(0, 0), old_end_point=endpoint(inserted), new_end_point=(0, 0))
                repaired = parser.parse(raw, broken)
                recovered = had_error and not repaired.root_node.has_error and shape(repaired) == expected_shape
            csts.append({"variant": variant, "has_error": initial_error, "sibling_preserved": sibling,
                         "sites": sites, "expected_cst_met": (not initial_error) == case["parse"] and sibling and all(s["passed"] for s in sites),
                         "incremental_recovery": recovered})
        flags = ["-std=" + case["mode"], "-pedantic-errors", "-fno-color-diagnostics"]
        check = run([compiler, *flags, "-fsyntax-only", native_path(source)], directory, "compiler")
        accepted = check["exit_code"] == 0
        check.update(accepted=accepted, passed=accepted == case["accepted"] and
                     (not case.get("diagnostic") or case["diagnostic"].lower() in check["output"].lower()))
        link, execution = None, None
        if accepted and case["execute"]:
            binary = directory / "fixture.program"
            link = run([compiler, *flags, native_path(source), "-o", native_path(binary)], directory, "link")
            if link["exit_code"] == 0:
                execution = run([native_path(binary)], directory, "runtime")
                execution.update(passed=execution["exit_code"] == 0 and execution["output"].strip() == "oracle:ok",
                                 executable_digest=digest(binary.read_bytes()))
        row = {"case": case["id"], "expected": case, "support_files": support, "source_digest": digest(raw), "cst": csts,
               "compiler": check, "link": link, "runtime": execution, "native_resolver": "not_run"}
        rows.append(row)
        print(json.dumps({"case": case["id"], "cst": {c["variant"]: c["expected_cst_met"] for c in csts},
                          "compiler": check["passed"], "runtime": execution["passed"] if execution else None}), flush=True)
    report = {"format": "entmoot.c_family_feature_qualification.v1", "inputs": manifest, "input_manifest_digest": digest(manifest_path.read_bytes()),
              "cases": rows, "limits": ["Compiler modes are distinct from historical toolchain versions; native Entmoot producers unqualified",
                 "C++ remains experimental; draft modes never imply stable support", "Only authored programs execute; grammar parses do not establish binds or include closure"]}
    report["passed"] = all(r["compiler"]["passed"] and all(c["expected_cst_met"] and c["incremental_recovery"] is not False for c in r["cst"]) and
                           (not r["expected"]["execute"] or r["runtime"] is not None and r["runtime"]["passed"]) for r in rows)
    with (out / "summary.json").open("x", encoding="utf-8", newline="\n") as stream:
        json.dump(report, stream, indent=2)
        stream.write("\n")
    raise SystemExit(0 if report["passed"] else 1)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
